title: Check voltage between terminals PM1 and E2 of engine control module.
ocr_text:
EG-551
ENGINE — 2JZ-GTE ENGINE TROUBLESHOOTING

2  Check voltage between terminals PM1 and E2 of engine control module.

ON

SST
ECM

B 65, 62

E2    PM1

BE8653
F46954

P  Turn ignition switch ON.

C  Measure voltage between terminals PM1 and E2 of engine control module.

OK  Voltage: 2.3 — 3.0 V

NG

OK  Check and replace engine control module.

3  Check for open and short in harness and connector between engine control module and turbo pressure sensor (See page IN–30).

OK

NG  Repair or replace harness or connector.

Replace turbo pressure sensor.
